name: OnlyFriends
source:
This story is about a group of friends from the sunny, coastal town of Paradise-Bay. You will play as a young boy who has returned to Paradise-Bay to his friends after having to move to another country with his parents. A lot has changed over the years, both you and your friends. Will you be able to maintain your friendship or will you succumb to temptation and lures, allowing secrets, intrigue, and lies to destroy it?
